tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen for its better defaults. Related recorded decisions: certificate verification is enabled on all builds, and https is used everywhere with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md` with a one-paragraph statement. It says the project's current recorded decision is rustls as the TLS backend, chosen for its better defaults. I checked this with `muninn show`. Decision #11 (rustls) replaced #9, which is retired, and the file doesn't mention #9's value.

The paragraph also notes two related decisions that are still current: certificate verification on all builds (#22), and https everywhere with no exceptions (#25).

A Muninn record from an earlier session (#23) says plain http for internal hosts. It is not in the catalog of current decisions and it conflicts with #25's "no exceptions". I left it out of the file, so you may want to confirm which one stands.

The first attempt to write the file through the shell failed with a parser error. I wrote it again with the file-write tool, and that worked.
